claim: On November 18, 2022 the Amazon Quick documentation history recorded that Amazon QuickSight now supports SPICE datasets that contain up to 1 billion (1,000,000,000) rows or 1 terabyte (TB) of data.
question: What was the SPICE dataset limit before the 2 billion row increase?

qualifiers.condition: Superseded: 2 billion rows (2025) and 2 TB (2026); current truth is quick-spice-enterprise-dataset-limit.
